scripts.gen:api: cargo run --quiet --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml --bin openapi > packages/api-client/openapi.json && npm run generate -w @yuppers/api-client
scripts.e2e: cargo build --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml --bin api --bin staff --bin worker && npm run build:web && npm run e2e -w @yuppers/web --
scripts.screenshots:sms: cargo build --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml --bin api && npm run screenshots:sms -w @yuppers/web
scripts.screenshots:sms:mobile: cargo build --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml --bin api && npm run screenshots:sms -w @yuppers/mobile
scripts.e2e:mobile: cargo build --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml --bin api && npm run e2e:export -w @yuppers/mobile && npm run e2e -w @yuppers/mobile --
